content: ListenBrainz auth: user token from https://listenbrainz.org/settings/; sent as Authorization: Token <token> header. GET /1/user/{mb_username}/listens returns recent listens (public, no auth needed to read another user's listens; auth token raises rate limit ceiling). Params: count (default 25, max 1000), max_ts/min_ts (mutually exclusive), results descending by listened_at.
